Lower Text: ＜Retaliation＞ (When only this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.)
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon.
[Your Turn] This Digimon can only digivolve into white Digimon.
[End of Opponent’s Turn] Delete this Digimon. Then, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Dark Masters] trait, other than [Piedmon], from your hand without paying the cost.
